open_items: ILO: chronic Cloudflare/WAF-shaped 403 pattern recurred at cycle 1450 (gateway metadata/data, direct metadata/data/json all 403, server: cloudflare, __cf_bm cookie present), after the longest clean streak on record (healthy continuously cycles 1439-1449, 11 cycles). Live recheck at run time confirmed still blocked; ECB checked simultaneously and returned 200, ruling out a network-side cause. Reported in incidents.md cycle 1450. Full prior occurrence list through cycle 1438 (re-derive from /api/history?hours=240 when next relevant): 1320, 1323, 1327-1328, 1330, 1333, 1342-1345, 1354-1355, 1363, 1366, 1378, 1382, 1385, 1389-1390, 1392, 1414, 1438. Not a gateway code bug; nothing to fix. Watch for recovery.

ESTAT: cycle 1447's gateway_issue (list_dataflows 60s timeout, already reported last run) cleared at cycle 1448 as expected. Flapped again at cycle 1449 with a different symptom, the chronic empty 'Error:' message bug (see below), then recovered by cycle 1450 (current, healthy). Reported in incidents.md cycle 1450. No action needed beyond the standing recommendation to fix the exception handler.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py lines 208-210 catching Exception and returning bare str(e), which is empty for some exception types): recurred on ESTAT at cycle 1449. Previously traced on ABS (most recently cycle 1403), ESTAT (cycles 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371, 1395, 1407, now 1449), ECB (cycles 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). Still unfixed; recommend logging repr(e) or type(e).__name__ instead of str(e) so the next occurrence is diagnosable.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1450 (confirmed by /api/contracts this run). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 162 as of this run (unchanged from last run), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. No contract-only degraded state occurred this run to re-confirm it, but the bug itself is unfixed.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped) when the endpoint is otherwise healthy; encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time across endpoints, verdict stays ok.
